pairs: For those who will be changed:
Deus, quoniam intraverunt aquæ usque ad animam meam.
for the waters have entered, even to my soul.
I have become stuck in a deep quagmire,
and there is no firm footing.
I have arrived at the height of the sea,
and a tempest has overwhelmed me.
while crying out. My jaws have become hoarse;
Meanwhile, I hope in my God.
Multiplicati sunt super capillos capitis mei qui oderunt me gratis.
Those who hate me without cause have been multiplied beyond the hairs of my head.
Confortati sunt qui persecuti sunt me inimici mei injuste;
My enemies, who persecuted me unjustly, have been strengthened.
Then I was required to pay for what I did not take.
et delicta mea a te non sunt abscondita.
and my offenses have not been hidden from you.
Non erubescant in me qui exspectant te,
Let those who wait for you,
non confundantur super me qui quærunt te,
not be shamed in me. Let those who seek you, O God of Israel,
For because of you, I have endured reproach;
I have become a stranger to my brothers
and a sojourner to the sons of my mother.
Quoniam zelus domus tuæ comedit me,
For zeal for your house has consumed me,
et opprobria exprobrantium tibi ceciderunt super me.
and the reproaches of those who reproached you have fallen upon me.
Et operui in jejunio animam meam,
And I covered my soul with fasting,
et factum est in opprobrium mihi.
and it has become a reproach to me.
And I put on a haircloth as my garment,
et factus sum illis in parabolam.
and I became a parable to them.
Adversum me loquebantur qui sedebant in porta,
Those who sat at the gate spoke against me,
et in me psallebant qui bibebant vinum.
and those who drank wine made me their song.
Ego vero orationem meam ad te,
But as for me, truly, my prayer is to you,
This time has pleased you well,
O God. In the multitude of your mercy,
exaudi me in veritate salutis tuæ.
in the truth of your salvation, hear me.
so that I may not become trapped.
libera me ab iis qui oderunt me,
Free me from those who hate me
Do not allow the tempest of water to submerge me,
nor the deep to absorb me.
neque urgeat super me puteus os suum.
And do not allow the well to close in on me.
for your mercy is kind. Look upon me,
secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum respice in me.
according to the fullness of your compassion.
Et ne avertas faciem tuam a puero tuo;
And do not turn your face away from your servant,
in conspectu tuo sunt omnes qui tribulant me.
All those who trouble me are in your sight;
Improperium exspectavit cor meum et miseriam:
my heart has anticipated reproach and misery.
And I sought for one who might grieve together with me,
and for one who might console me,
Et dederunt in escam meam fel,
And they gave me gall for my food.
et in siti mea potaverunt me aceto.
And in my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
Fiat mensa eorum coram ipsis in laqueum,
Let their table be a snare before them,
so that they may not see,
and may their back always be crooked.
Pour out your indignation upon them,
et furor iræ tuæ comprehendat eos.
and may the fury of your anger take hold of them.
May their dwelling place be deserted,
et in tabernaculis eorum non sit qui inhabitet.
and may there be no one who dwells in their tabernacles.
Quoniam quem tu percussisti persecuti sunt,
For they persecuted whomever you struck.
et super dolorem vulnerum meorum addiderunt.
And they have added to the grief of my wounds.
Assign an iniquity upon their iniquity,
et non intrent in justitiam tuam.
and may they not enter into your justice.
Delete them from the Book of the Living,
and let them not be written down with the just.
I will praise the name of God with a canticle,
and I will magnify him with praise.
et placebit Deo super vitulum novellum,
And it will please God more than a new calf producing horns
For the Lord has heard the poor,
and he has not despised his prisoners.
Let the heavens and the earth praise him:
and everything that crawls in it.
and the cities of Judah will be built up.
and they will acquire it by inheritance.
Et semen servorum ejus possidebit eam;
And the offspring of his servants will possess it;
et qui diligunt nomen ejus habitabunt in ea.
and those who love his name will dwell in it.
